import trimesh, numpy as np
h = trimesh.load('exports/model.hanger.bb97b27d.stl')
zs = np.linspace(0.05, 33.95, 680)
origins = np.column_stack([np.zeros_like(zs), np.full_like(zs, 60.0), zs])
dirs = np.tile([0.0, -1.0, 0.0], (len(zs), 1))
loc, rid, tid = h.ray.intersects_location(origins, dirs, multiple_hits=True)
top_y = np.full(len(zs), -1.0)
for i, loc_i in enumerate(loc):
    top_y[rid[i]] = max(top_y[rid[i]], loc_i[1])
crown = top_y.max()
for tol in [0.05, 0.25, 1.0]:
    band = zs[top_y > crown - tol]
    print(f'within {tol} mm of crown: z {band.min():.2f}..{band.max():.2f} -> {band.max()-band.min():.2f} mm wide')
# crown arc height drop across +-30 mm along X at Z=17
for x in [0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60]:
    hits = h.contains(np.array([[float(x), 41.6, 17.0]]))
    # find top by binary search
    lo, hi = 0.0, 45.0
    for _ in range(40):
        mid = (lo+hi)/2
        if h.contains(np.array([[float(x), mid, 17.0]]))[0]: lo = mid
        else: hi = mid
    print(f'x={x}: crown y={lo:.2f}')
